title: Webhook route re-read an already-consumed request stream and hung
symptom: Every POST to /api/webhooks/stripe timed out: the dispatcher had already consumed req into `raw`, and the route handler called readRaw(req) again, so 'data'/'end' never fired and the promise never resolved.
reproduce: All four signature tests timed out at 5000ms.
expected: The handler uses the `raw` argument the dispatcher already collected; signature tests respond in milliseconds.
regression_test: server/test/webhooks.test.ts — 5 webhook tests assert 200/400 responses that would hang on the defect
bench_note: failing state never committed; record kept for honesty
notes: Caught by the first real test run; fixed in the same change.
